title: Positive Snapshot Block Width
statement: For every finite-state binary Turing machine $M$ and every binary code for its optional states, the width of a snapshot block is positive.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state binary Turing machine
A binary code is given for the optional states of $M$
replaced: For every machine and optional-state binary code, the snapshot block width is positive, since every product code contains at least the two input-symbol bits.
